headline: Session-first Combo Dose, exact-vial details and DS2 refinements

changes.title: Simpler Combo Dose logging
changes.detail: Choose multiple compounds, enter shared session details once, work through focused compound dose/source fields, and confirm on a dedicated Review step.

changes.title: Clear mg/mcg entry with strict inventory accounting
changes.detail: Switch display units without changing entered mass, retain native historical unit representation and audit entered amount/unit, and reject strict vial shortfalls including 1 mcg cases.

changes.title: View preparation details for the selected physical vial
changes.detail: Read preparation details from the exact physical vial or vial-ID-matched recon history without borrowing unrelated kit defaults; Stash vial detail is read-only.

changes.title: Consistent dose header, selection chevrons and field spacing
changes.detail: Apply the approved DS2 DM Sans form heading, accessible close target and visible outline chevrons to unit, source and shared administration selectors with more breathing room.

dataImpact: No destructive migration or overwrite of existing production localStorage (peptide-tracker-html-v1). No automatic rewrite of old dose records, saved history, kit records, Check-Ins or inventory. New Combo Dose records retain the established native numeric dose format plus optional enteredAmount/enteredUnit audit metadata. Successful logged doses only debit eligible exact vial sources through the existing guarded exclusive writer. Demo data remains entirely isolated.
limitations: Prepared-dose use delegates to the established prepared-syringe confirmation flow; unsupported administration-method and multi-source combinations fail closed rather than inventing new physical transactions.
LIVE nasal administration and generic preparation transfers remain OFF; previously approved recorded preparation flow remains unchanged.

The full offline DEMO intentionally uses fallback fonts. LIVE source preserves external DM Sans/Fraunces/DM Mono import; actual online font-file rendering and VoiceOver/Dynamic Type were not independently accepted in this release session.
Automated vial-source and measurement regressions passed; synthetic calculator diagnostics do not establish independent clinical certification.
Product UI reviewed through user-provided iPhone screenshots and user approval; no separate physical VoiceOver audit is claimed.
Release metadata is reconciled after merge; app source parity was independently verified at squash merge fe51ace9 before metadata publication.
